text: Chery Automobile's HKEX prospectus (17 Sep 2025) shows state entities held about 34.7% of the company before its September 2025 IPO and about 34.5% after the partial over-allotment exercise: Wuhu Investment Holding 20.08% at listing (single largest shareholder; itself owned 95.59% by Wuhu SASAC and 4.41% by the Anhui Provincial Department of Finance), Anhui Credit Guaranty 9.46% (wholly owned by the People's Government of Anhui Province) and Anhui Investment Holding 4.93% (wholly owned by Anhui SASAC). The prospectus states the company has 22 shareholders with a dispersed structure and is not a state-owned, state-controlled or state-actually-controlled enterprise under the PRC state-asset supervision measures.
